# Fixing a bicycle chain

A stretched chain wears the cassette, so measure it every few months.

## Tools

You need a chain tool, a quick link and a ruler.

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Chain tool | push out a pin |
| Quick link | close the chain |
| Ruler | measure wear |

```bash
echo "12 links should measure 304.8 mm"
```

The manual is online: [chain care](https://example.com/chain).

Replace the chain at 0.75 percent stretch to save the cassette.
Clean and lube the chain after wet rides.
A good habit costs little and saves a lot.
